Boxing Random is a 2-player, physics-based sports action game developed by RHM Interactive. 
Gameplay and Overview
Objective: The first player to reach a score of 5 wins the match.
Mechanics: Matches use unpredictable ragdoll physics where a single action button controls jumping, moving, and punching simultaneously.
Random Elements: Every round randomly changes the arena, weather, character outfits, and modifiers—such as surprise power-ups or a long-range rocket punch.
Modes: Supports both single-player against an AI opponent and 2-player local multiplayer. 
Apple
 +3
Controls
Single Player: Use the Up arrow key.
Two Players: Player 1 uses the W key and Player 2 uses the Up arrow key (or via mouse/tap controls depending on the platform version). 
You can play it in web browsers via platforms like CrazyGames or on mobile through the Two Player Games portal and app stores.
